startup_file.tagline: US health-insurance startup for small businesses (YC winter 2020)
startup_file.what: AI-powered platform that helps small businesses choose and manage 'level-funded' health plans, integrating with payroll and HR systems. Level-funded sits between fully insured (carrier bears all risk, higher and predictable cost) and self-funded (employer bears cost, unpredictable): the business makes predictable payments, is insured against unusually high costs, and may get a share of the surplus back if claims stay low.
how: The article does not say how Angle itself earns its revenue.
It says the startup serves 5,000+ businesses and is profitable.
startup_file.watch: A profitable, non-'AI agent' company raising a large Series C is unusual per TechCrunch. The tender offer is liquidity for staff, not money into the company.
